mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_webchat_conversation ( tenant_id, visitor_id, profile_name, contact_id, lead_id, last_message_at, last_message_preview, last_customer_message_at, last_outbound_at, unread_count, status, user_id, owner, assigned_at, hosted_by_ai, closed_at, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{visitorId}, #{profileName}, #{contactId}, #{leadId}, #{lastMessageAt}, #{lastMessagePreview}, #{lastCustomerMessageAt}, #{lastOutboundAt}, COALESCE(#{unreadCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{status}, 'active'), #{userId}, #{owner}, #{assignedAt}, #{hostedByAi}, #{closedAt}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, now()), #{updateTime} )
